num_jobs: <int> Total number of jobs to be processed across all machines.
num_machines: <int> Number of identical parallel batch-processing machines available.
batch_capacity: <int> Maximum total size of jobs that can be processed together in a single batch.

jobs.release_date: <int> Earliest time at which the job becomes available for processing.
jobs.processing_time: <int> Duration required to process the job.
jobs.size: <int> Amount of machine capacity the job consumes when assigned to a batch.
